verdict.rationale: Deepgram has a dedicated multilingual voice agent guide, which frames the setup as choosing an STT model to transcribe the user and a TTS model to speak the agent. That supports running conversations in non-English languages, but the evidence is a single thin mention and says nothing about detecting or switching language mid-call. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic language detection, mid-call language switching, the list of supported languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
